data.title: Clarity Act fallout: crypto’s Fairshake PAC commits $30 million against Sherrod Brown
data.summary_raw: Crypto PAC Fairshake is throwing $30 million into an Ohio race against former Sen. Sherrod Brown, who has been skeptical of crypto.
